title: Log It First
style: bass house, 128 BPM, punchy kick, hard drop, SRE culture theme, dry male vocal, chantable chorus, industrial synth, data discipline energy, procedural urgency, original sound, V4_5ALL
lyrics:
[VERSE 1]
Before you fix it — log it
Before you patch it — log it
Before the thread goes cold
Before the story's sold — log it

Timestamp on the moment
Evidence before the fix
Logs don't lie like people
Logs don't pull their tricks

[CHORUS]
Log it first — log it first
Before you touch a single line
Log it first — log it first
The evidence is yours not mine
Log it first — log it first
Timestamp everything you find
Log it first — log it first
Leave the noise behind

[VERSE 2]
Sev2 on a Tuesday
No one wants to own it
But the log already shows it
Can't delete — can't disown it

Human in the loop — always
Bot recorded — always
Audit trail complete — always
Log it first — always

[DROP]
Log it — log it — log it first
Evidence before the burst
Log it — log it — log it first
Data over feelings — first

[OUTRO]
Log it first.
Every time.
No exceptions.
